tagline: A governed AI automation prototype for a managed service provider
_notes: author_line and contact_url are the ONLY place the owner's name may appear; scan/privacy-scan.ps1 -AllowConfig exempts exactly these two strings and nothing else. No email and no phone are shipped.
robots_noindex keeps the site out of search engines; the link still works for anyone it is handed to. Set it to false to be indexed.
The site never names a real company or person other than the author; scan/privacy-scan.ps1 and the banned-word list in stats.py check.
